materials.topic: 大件闲置：能用不等于有人接
materials.text: 赵先生的椭圆仪能正常运转，家里有电梯。挂二手平台几个月无人问津，回收商不收，最后倒付70元请人清走。记者看到买家先问在哪、有没有电梯、能不能帮搬。回收商要承担仓储运输人工成本。

source.evidence_text: 赵先生的椭圆仪能正常运转，家里有电梯。挂二手平台几个月无人问津，回收商不收，最后倒付70元请人清走。记者看到买家先问在哪、有没有电梯、能不能帮搬。回收商要承担仓储运输人工成本。

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-10-20T23:34:20Z
今年上半年，北京市民赵先生打算处理家里闲置的椭圆仪。他先联系厂家，对方表示不提供回收服务；把信息挂到二手交易平台，几个月时间无人问津；又辗转找到专做家具、健身器材回收的商家，得到的答复同样是“不收”。
赵先生家住南四环，楼层不高且有电梯，搬运物品并不困难，可即便如此，这台仍能正常运转的椭圆仪，始终找不到合适的人接手。最终，他只能找来一位收废品的师傅，倒付70元，才把这件“大件”从家里清了出去。
记者浏览二手交易平台发现，在不少大件家具交易帖文下，买家最关注的问题往往不是价格，而是“在哪个地方”“有没有电梯”“能不能帮忙搬”。对于跨区域交易而言，运输成本更成为难以绕开的障碍；即便是同城交易，大件旧物也往往需要专业工具和多人协作才能完成搬运，而这些额外成本，很容易超过商品本身的价值。由此也导致大件旧物在二手交易平台很难卖出——买家不愿意承担运输成本，卖家包运送的话售价就要大幅上涨，导致买卖双方难以达成交易合意。
多位受访从业者向记者表示，对于回收企业而言，回收一件大件旧物并不意味着能够立即实现价值转化。在等待交易、拆解或再利用的过程中，仓储、运输和人工成本仍在持续产生。

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-10-20T06:00:19Z
After Catherine Warrilow sold a Zara necklace for £6 on Vinted, she packed it up and posted it off, just as she had done with many things before. Only this time the buyer claimed the parcel arrived empty.
Warrilow, 47, from Oxford, provided Vinted with photos and videos of the package, including date-stamped Ring doorbell footage of her leaving the house to post it. But she says the resale platform refunded the buyer and left her out of pocket.
“I challenged Vinted on what evidence they had and asked them to supply it, but they simply said ‘based on our evidence’ and ‘our evidence suggests’ and could not explain what that was,” she says. “The photos from the buyer showed that all of the parcel tape I’d used had been removed.”
According to Vinted, all appeals are handled by human reviewers, including Warrilow’s cases.

materials.topic: 误投信箱后的长期互助
materials.text: 村民曾拆门板抬受伤的王保贵就医，还凑钱帮他养伤。1976年邮递员误把他家信箱当全村公用信箱，他便义务送报送信，延续50年。年轻时步行，现在骑三轮车。他还自费订农业报刊，复印核桃种植技术给村民。

source.evidence_text: 村民曾拆门板抬受伤的王保贵就医，还凑钱帮他养伤。1976年邮递员误把他家信箱当全村公用信箱，他便义务送报送信，延续50年。年轻时步行，现在骑三轮车。他还自费订农业报刊，复印核桃种植技术给村民。

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-10-20T15:26:01Z
1968年，一场意外事故令王保贵右臂受重伤。危急关头，全村人自发赶来，有人撕衣包扎，有人拆下门板做成担架，众人接力把他送往医院，使他保住一条命。
养伤期间，村民和同事自发捐款，一毛、两毛凑钱帮助他渡过难关。这份情谊，他一直铭记于心。从那时起，他便下定决心，要用实际行动回馈乡里。
1976年，邮递员误把他家信箱当成全村公用信箱，家里常堆满别人的报刊和信件，王保贵没有置之不理，主动担起义务投递的担子，这一干就是整整50年。“早年身体好，我靠步行投递；现在年纪大了，我骑三轮车送报。”王保贵说。
近年来，村里发展核桃种植产业，王保贵自费订阅农业科技类报刊，把有关核桃种植的技术内容复印下来，分发到村民手中。由于经常送报，王保贵成了村民眼里“最可信的人”，就连大学录取通知书、汇款单等，村民也都放心托付他代收。

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-09-10T00:00:00Z
The first specimen was unearthed in the late 1990s by Dr Burkhard Pohl, founder of the Wyoming Dinosaur Center, after he spotted a belemnite much bigger than any he had seen before. The fossil sat unstudied in the museum's collection draw for many years until a second specimen was discovered by fossil collector Cliff Linster near Ten Sleep, Wyoming, and donated to the Wyoming Dinosaur Center in 2019. Together, the two fossils provided the evidence needed to identify and formally describe the new species. 
The name Wyoteuthis translates to “a squid from Wyoming”, while the species name, linsterorum , honours Cliff Linster and his family. Cliff discovered one of only two known specimens of the new species and donated it for scientific study. Cliff Linster passed away in June this year. He knew researchers were studying his remarkable discovery and was excited to see it formally described.

2026-10-20T06:00:19Z
The record-breaking heat in London, in summer 2022, resulted in an appalling problem in my neighbourhood – which one man took on, armed only with a jet wash. My neighbour disappeared briefly, and returned carrying a jet washer. There was splat, a yell and a blossom of what looked like rice grains were blasted into the air.
Maggots. Hundreds – maybe even thousands – of maggots, propelled into flight and falling on windows, walls, cars, gardens, hedges, pavements and bins all around. I thanked the universe I’d kept my window closed, as they landed on the windowsill, still wriggling their last wriggle. Some neighbours obviously thought that rain had finally come in the form of hail. They opened their doors to see. And then they too were hit by the unfolding horror.
There stood the neighbour, stray maggots in his hair and on his face, before he went inside to fetch the dustpan and brush.

2026-10-20T14:24:34Z
据黄炯回忆，闲聊时，柏大卫总爱提起少年趣事：放羊放牛、下河游泳，和伙伴在田埂偷拔萝卜，被农户追得四处跑。讲完总笑着自嘲：“当年我也当了一回‘贼娃子’(湟源话，小偷)。”
“有一年，柏大卫打车进入西宁，刚一开口，流利的湟源土话便让司机吃惊。”黄炯说，司机不肯收车费，只留下一句话：“大卫先生，您为青海人做了那么多事，这趟车我不能收钱。”
“美国洋人大鼻子，好吃中国的酿皮子，又调辣子又调醋，辣子抹了一鼻子……”柏大卫听完后大笑不止，连声叫好，并请求好友写下童谣，带回美国。“他说他将装裱好的童谣挂在卧室里，每天一睁眼，就能看见那几行字，那是故乡湟源的声音。”黄炯说。

The method
 
 Use clean, sharp scissors and cut along the leaf’s natural shape. Leave a thin sliver of the brown edge rather than cutting into the healthy green tissue, which would create a fresh wound that the plant then has to seal off, causing it to go brown again in the process.
The test
 
 I trimmed the brown tips on a philodendron, following the leaf shape, and the leaves immediately looked neater and, over time, didn’t brown further along the cut. On an earlier attempt years ago, I cut back into the green part of the leaf and watched a new brown edge form within days.

In one of the biggest surprises of NASA's OSIRIS-REx mission, its target asteroid, Bennu, turned out to be a jagged, rugged world covered in large boulders, with few of the smooth patches that earlier observations from Earth-based instruments had indicated.
Ryan's team scrutinized rock particles collected from Bennu’s surface using a variety of laboratory analysis techniques. In a study published in Nature Communications the authors reported that the boulders are indeed porous enough to account for some of the observed heat loss, but not all of it. Rather, many of the rocks turned out to be riddled with extensive networks of cracks.
“The sample goes into its own ‘spacesuit,’ gets a CT scan, and then comes back to its pristine environment, all without having any exposure to the terrestrial environment,” said Nicole Lunning, lead OSIRIS-REx sample curator within the Astromaterials Research and Exploration Science division at NASA Johnson and one of the study's co-authors. “We can image right through these airtight containers to visualize the shape and internal structure of the rock that's inside.”

中新网甘肃敦煌10月21日电 (记者 李亚龙)20日，“发现最美铁路·穿越丝路筑梦山海”网络宣传活动在甘肃敦煌火车站启动。由中央、省、市媒体记者，主要新闻网站及自媒体平台相关负责人，铁路宣传骨干组成的40余人采访拍摄团，将在4天时间里沿敦煌、玉门、嘉峪关等古丝路重要节点城市，开展体验式采访。
本次活动由中央网信办网络社会工作局、中国国家铁路集团有限公司党组宣传部联合主办，甘肃省委网信办、中国铁路兰州局集团有限公司党委宣传部承办。活动期间，采访拍摄团队将走进铁路生产一线，实地采访西北铁路的建设与运营脉动。
在沙山沟铁路特大桥，记者们将深入活动性沙漠腹地，看风沙之中架起的超级工程；赴玉门，走进铁人王进喜纪念馆，追寻铁人精神，观察铁路为石油工业外运护航的路径；深入嘉峪关客车整备所和动态检测班组，近距离了解大数据、人工智能技术如何为列车做日常“体检”。
在嘉峪关机务段管控中心，采访拍摄团队将观摩列车运行集中调度、机车状态实时监测全过程；在兰新高铁下穿明长城隧道段落，体会工程推进与文物保护并行的建设理念；并实地记录中欧班列与天下第一雄关同框的场景，见证千年古丝路借助钢铁轨道焕发新的时代活力。
据介绍，此次采访旨在全景展现西北铁路高质量发展成效，观察铁路深度融入地方经济社会发展、助力河西走廊文旅产业升级、保障能源物资运输的具体实践，呈现铁路服务和支撑西部大开发的担当作为。(完)

materials.topic: 顺风车绕路接人
materials.text: 闫女士去机场选择顺风车，原本一个半小时的路，绕路接人又花大约一个小时。陈贤说跨城出行时遇到车主出发前私下加二十块钱。报道讨论真假顺风车的合规边界；乘客体验来自采访自述。顺风车责任需要核对。

source.evidence_text: 闫女士去机场选择顺风车，原本一个半小时的路，绕路接人又花大约一个小时。陈贤说跨城出行时遇到车主出发前私下加二十块钱。报道讨论真假顺风车的合规边界；乘客体验来自采访自述。

source_evidence.excerpt:
节假日回老家抢不到高铁票，或者去机场时公共交通不便，乘客闫女士会选择顺风车，价格相对便宜，又能省去换乘的麻烦，但有时候司机并不是单纯顺路捎带。
闫女士表示，有时候上车之后发现车主会在好几个平台上接单，一路上会多次绕路去接人，原本到机场只需要花费一个半小时，但是绕路接人就要花费大约一个小时。
陈贤：我感觉打到的基本上都不是顺风车，更像是固定跑这条跨城线路的营运性质的车，其中有一位车主在出发前跟我联系，私下加了二十块钱，这种顺风车更像是当生意在跑。
绕路、加价，除了影响乘车体验，背后还触碰了顺风车的边界问题：到底什么才算真正的顺路合乘？

materials.topic: 付费内推的层层话术
materials.text: 部门风险提示描述假央国企招聘：先用不限专业等信息引流，再声称只有付费内推能面试，编造聊天记录或录用材料，最后以服务费和打点费收费，收款后拖延甚至失联。没有一名完整受访求职者案例。

source.evidence_text: 部门风险提示描述假央国企招聘：先用不限专业等信息引流，再声称只有付费内推能面试，编造聊天记录或录用材料，最后以服务费和打点费收费，收款后拖延甚至失联。没有一名完整受访求职者案例。

source_evidence.excerpt:
有关部门提示，不法分子实施诈骗往往首先冒用央国企名义编造虚假招聘信息进行引流，通过社交、直播、短视频平台或线上社群、网络论坛、交流社区等，以“央国企就业”“央国企指导”“央国企规划”等为噱头，发布“中国××集团急招数万人”“不限专业、基本报名就能进”“年薪××万、有正式编制”等虚假或夸大信息，用话术引流，吸引求职者咨询。
此后，再虚构“内部推荐渠道”骗取信任。如自称拥有企业人事内部人脉，暗示掌握“少量内部名额”“有内推、实习等资源可对接”，谎称“普通网投简历无法通过筛选，只有付费内推才能直通面试官”，渲染岗位名额紧张、错过不再有的紧迫感。有的还编造聊天记录、成功案例，甚至伪造劳动合同、就业协议，让求职者误以为其有“背景”、有“关系”。
最终，巧立名目收取费用实施诈骗。不法分子最终目的是骗取钱财，会以“内推服务费”“面试打点费”“定金”等多种名义收取费用。收款后，常以“政策变化”“领导调整”等理由拖延搪塞，甚至直接失联。
有关部门提示，不法分子实施诈骗多以应届高校毕业生为主要对象。高校毕业生求职经验不足，对正规招录流程不熟悉，容易被虚假承诺诱导；家长对孩子就业格外关心，易受焦虑情绪影响，轻信“托关系走门路”的说辞。

source_evidence.excerpt:
中新网10月21日电 据中央气象台网站消息，气象监测显示，过去一天，受冷空气影响，北方多地出现大风降温天气，内蒙古中部、西北地区东部、华北、黄淮、东北地区等地降温幅度达到6～10℃，局地降温超过12℃；21日早晨，最低气温0℃线位于河北中部至陕西中部、甘肃南部一带，北京城区气温仅有5℃左右。与北方秋凉形成鲜明反差，我国华南地区仍在经历夏季的晴热，广东、广西部分站点日最高气温达到35℃。
中央气象台预计，21日，新疆、内蒙古、华北北部等地气温仍将继续下滑，降温幅度有4～6℃，上述地区并伴有4～6级偏北风，阵风7～9级。本周内，北方地区还将有一次冷空气活动，但影响区域主要集中在长江中下游以北地区，华南大部地区气温将维持较高状态。
气象专家提醒，近期北方冷空气活跃，气温起伏较为剧烈，建议公众做好防风保暖措施；新疆北部雨雪范围广，需防范强降雪对交通出行、旅游等的不利影响。

materials.topic: 农村免费流感疫苗通知
materials.text: 广东疾控局通知农村65周岁及以上老年人和义务教育阶段中小学生可免费接种1剂次三价流感裂解疫苗。符合对象但居住在非农村地区，每县区也会指定门诊；具体地点需查看当地公示。

source.evidence_text: 广东疾控局通知农村65周岁及以上老年人和义务教育阶段中小学生可免费接种1剂次三价流感裂解疫苗。符合对象但居住在非农村地区，每县区也会指定门诊；具体地点需查看当地公示。

source_evidence.excerpt:
中新网广州10月20日电 (记者 蔡敏婕)广东省疾控局20日发布消息称，今年广东省农村地区的65岁以上老年人和义务教育阶段中小学生可免费接种流感疫苗，相关接种工作已经开始。
根据通知，广东农村地区以下两类人群可享受1剂次三价流感裂解疫苗免费接种：65周岁及以上老年人(接种时须年满65周岁)；义务教育阶段中小学生。已经实施流感疫苗免费接种政策的地区按当地现行政策执行。
如果居住在农村地区，可直接到当地乡镇卫生院的预防接种门诊接种。农村地区养老机构的老人和在校义务教育阶段中小学生将以所在单位/学校为单位统一组织，分时段分批安排接种。
如果属于农村地区免费接种对象，但居住在非农村地区，每个县(市、区)也会指定接种门诊为符合条件的人群提供免费流感疫苗接种服务，具体接种门诊可留意所在地区的公示信息。

source_evidence.excerpt:
中新网上海10月20日电 (记者 殷立勤)10月20日，沪港机场国际航空人才培训中心揭牌仪式在上海举行。该培训中心将围绕“四大核心维度”构建特色人才培养体系：理念上坚持开放共赢，依托沪港两地超大型航空枢纽实战运营经验、先进治理范式和成熟培训体系，打造植根内地、联通香港、对标国际、服务全国的航空人才培养新平台；模式上推进沪港双城联动，坚持理论引领、场景实训、案例赋能、经验共享四位一体，突出需求为本和实战导向；课程上既覆盖机场运行、安全服务、商业经营等核心业务，也前瞻布局数智机场、航空碳管理、国际枢纽治理等新兴赛道；师资上汇聚沪港两地机场中高层管理者、行业专家和学界力量，并与行业各方共研开发、互派人才、互通师资，打造“共建共享、互通互利”的产教融合发展新路。
当日，2026北外滩国际航运论坛的主论坛之一——2026北外滩国际航空论坛在上海世界会客厅举行。论坛以“和合共融 韧性发展——共建开放协同的全球航空新生态”为主题，汇聚全球300多位航空领域嘉宾，共探全球航空治理新图景。

materials.topic: 15分钟亲水圈
materials.text: 银川发布会称城市15分钟亲水圈基本建成，列出宝湖公园、华雁湖沙滩等地点，介绍排污口整治和水系连通。报道没有逐户步行实测，也没有居民使用前后经历。

source.evidence_text: 银川发布会称城市15分钟亲水圈基本建成，列出宝湖公园、华雁湖沙滩等地点，介绍排污口整治和水系连通。报道没有逐户步行实测，也没有居民使用前后经历。

source_evidence.excerpt:
中新网银川10月20日电(记者 于晶)宁夏回族自治区政府新闻办公室20日举行“全面推行河湖长制10周年奋力绘就人水和谐新画卷”新闻发布会。银川市委常委、副市长党成介绍，10年来，银川依托“塞上湖城”禀赋，以河湖长制为总抓手，扭转过去人水相望、临水难近的格局，城市“15分钟亲水圈”基本建成，宝湖公园、华雁湖沙滩、阅海湖芦苇岛、典农河溢流堰成为市民家门口亲水打卡地。
据介绍，银川持续开展“清四乱”、污染治理，全市281个入河排污口全部整治到位，黄河干流宁夏段水质连续9年稳定保持Ⅱ类，入黄排水沟水质全面达标，湖泊水质稳定达到Ⅳ类及以上。
在生态修复领域，银川划定湿地保护红线，完善专项规划，落实湿地占补平衡，十年累计投入40多亿元，修复湿地1.2万公顷，连通水系150公里，沿黄生态屏障不断筑牢。同时对典农河、阅海湖等重点水域实施靶向治理，完成108.5公里河道水系整治，切断污染链条；常态化实施再生水生态补水，每年节约黄河水近2000万立方米。
生态改善推动生物多样性恢复，银川市水生动植物达120余种，候鸟数量较10年前增长160%，鸣翠湖湿地成为候鸟重要栖息区域。

source_evidence.excerpt: For years, Chromebooks have been the boss of budget laptops, but Googlebooks take a different, far more premium approach. Made by a range of traditional PC makers, including Acer, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo, they start at £999 (€1,099/$899/A$2,299) – a far cry from the £160 Chromebooks. But the software is essentially Android underneath, which means getting it up and running is just like setting up an Android phone: scan the QR code with your phone, enter a passcode and transfer your apps and accounts. It is all done and dusted in about four minutes, which is faster than setting up a modern Windows 11 machine even if you know all the shortcuts. Access to the full gamut of Android apps is the Googlebook’s biggest strength and its greatest weakness. Practically any app you have on your phone can be installed and run on the laptop. source_evidence.excerpt: I’m hiking the new Llwybr Coedwig Cymru Trail, or Wales Forest Trail. Running from Porthkerry Park, near Barry, to Pont Walby, close to Glynneath, this 50-mile (80km) pilot route is the first section of what the National Forest for Wales hopes will eventually be a trail linking woodlands across the length and breadth of Wales: a sylvan counterpart to the Wales Coast Path. My father grew up in one of the valleys’ mining villages and, when I visited relatives there as a child, the disconnection of those post-industrial communities from the wild hills that loomed above them was striking. Mountain bikers have long discovered the region’s potential, but walkers still tend to head for the more obvious trails that wind through the national parks or along the coast. This pilot trail seems a good excuse to explore untapped footpaths. I swerve on to a fern-fringed path and follow a stream to the outskirts of Barry. source_evidence.excerpt: For every Halloween party I went to as a child, my mum made me the same costume: bin-bag bat. Black base layer, fangs drawn on with eyeliner, and wings cut out of bin bags and attached to the sleeves. Surprisingly effective, cheap and with a five-minute assembly time (particularly helpful as I was the youngest of four), the costume became such a habit that I’ve fallen back on it many times in adulthood too; my friends even dressed up as a colony of bin-bag bats for my hen party. “When we were kids we sometimes wore our ballet outfits and then drew ‘scary’ makeup to look like broken ballerinas – ‘cracks’ drawn with eyebrow pencil, bright red lipstick,” says the Filter’s audience editor Ella Jinadu. “These days, I think wearing an LED face mask without the light turned on would be pretty terrifying.” One anonymous reader says a ninja is a great idea for kids if you’re pressed for time: “You just need a black turtleneck, an oversized black T-shirt cinched with a belt and a sword – my son made one out of cardboard.”

Díaz and Junior Caminero each hit a two-run homer, Freddy Peralta pitched 5 1/3 gritty innings and the Rays beat the Cleveland Guardians 7-3 in Game 6 of the American League Championship Series on Monday night to win their third pennant in 29 seasons as a major league franchise. materials.topic: AI泡沫破裂反而加快替人
materials.text: NPR作者提出假设：若AI泡沫破裂引发衰退，企业降成本反而可能加快自动化。作者明确自己仍怀疑大而化之的AI预测，也不知道会发生什么。这是情景推演，不是本轮观察到的失业事实。

source.author: Greg Rosalsky

source_evidence.excerpt: What if an AI bubble bursts, triggering a recession, and that recession ends up accelerating the replacement of workers with AI? Call it the AI double whammy. I've long been skeptical of sweeping claims about how AI will transform the world. I still am. We don't really know. But as this technology advances, I've found myself worrying more about what it could mean for our livelihoods. We tend to imagine automation as a gradual process. Technology improves, businesses adopt it, and jobs slowly change or disappear, theoretically while new jobs appear in other parts of the economy. But this research suggests that automation can happen in bursts, and those bursts tend to cluster around recessions. It's a nightmare scenario. First, the bust hammers our retirement savings. Then, as businesses scramble to cut costs, many of our jobs are permanently lost. But it felt cathartic writing this down — getting these worries out of my head and onto the page.

source_evidence.excerpt: You are the mayor. You know exactly what this city needs. Now get it past the zoning board, the neighbors, the appeals court and the next election. Permit Pending is a city simulation in the spirit of the classics, with one difference: you are not a god. You are an elected mayor. Every apartment block, bus lane and factory goes through hearings, reviews, objections, lawsuits and appeals. The economy underneath is real. The neighbors are not always rational. Win the argument, or win the election. Ideally both. A typical case from your inbox. The economic answer was obvious. The political path was not.

source_evidence.excerpt:
2026-10-19T00:00:00-04:00
As of iPadOS 27, if you have multiple windows open while AirPlaying (whether or not Stage Manager is on), tapping on anything other than the presenting app will snap the external display into showing your whole iPad screen. This means that my students see all my notes on who I want to call on, or poll results that should be hidden from them. They also get distracted from what we’re learning by all these jarring windows popping up and disappearing. If you’re presenting at a big conference, it’s extremely embarrassing.
In GoodNotes, the presenter view will return once you tap back on the app. In Keynote, it will just exit the presentation entirely. In PowerPoint, it will put the app in a limbo where you have to restart the presentation to proceed. Here’s a Reddit post illustrating the behavior in GoodNotes. But don’t just take my word for it; try it at home!

materials.topic: The Future of CSS
materials.text: For the past few years, all of the major browser vendors (Google, Apple, Microsoft, and Mozilla, along with Igalia and Bocoup) have been working together on Interop(opens in new tab), a project to improve universal browser support on web technologies. It’s been a remarkably successful effort; when a focus area gets added to Interop, it often winds up reaching near-100% support across all major browsers within a year. ✨ CSS Subgrid is a good example. Subgrid is a super-powerful extension to CSS Grid which enables entirely new layouts. It was implemented in Firefox back in 2019, but there wasn’t much movement with other browsers for years. It got added to Interop 2023, and by the end of that year, it was widely available across all modern browsers: As we reach the end of 2026, Interop 2027 is currently being planned, and the team at Mozilla has created a ranking system(opens in new tab) for us to upvote our most-requested features. materials.topic: Nano Banana 2.1 – Model Card
materials.text: Model Cards are intended to provide essential information on Gemini models, including known limitations, mitigation approaches, and safety performance. Model cards may be updated from time to time; for example, to include updated evaluations as the model is improved or revised. Nano Banana 2.1 is a member of the Gemini 3 series of models, a suite of highly-capable, natively multimodal reasoning models. Nano Banana 2.1 can comprehend input from different information sources, including text and images. Image and text output is generated in the response. Text strings (e.g., a prompt, document(s)) and images, with a token context window of up to 1M.

materials.topic: Show HN: acplause – An ACP agent for OpenAI-compatible APIs
materials.text: acplause is an Agent Client Protocol v2 agent. Your editor talks to it over stdio; it thinks with any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API, OpenRouter first, and works in your workspace through tools. Inspired by acp-bridge, which serves as a behavioral reference for the tool loop, limits and error handling. acplause follows the pinned ACP v2 specification for its wire protocol. acplause is experimental. Calendar versions identify releases; they do not promise compatibility. Breaking changes are highlighted in release notes.

materials.topic: C# now beats Rust on WASM size
materials.text: Compile C# and .NET CIL to small standalone Wasm with WASI (AOT with built-in Runtime and Precise GC) Independent .NET for WebAssembly and WASI. Write C#. Deploy small, standalone Wasm. NetWasm is an independent compiler, CoreLib, runtime and SDK that compiles C# and .NET CIL directly to WebAssembly. It does not carry the desktop CLR, Mono, dotnet.js or application DLLs into production.
